GASOLINE HANDLING

     Do not refuel the power unit and do not handle or leave open gasoline containers or
plastic gasoline containers in the vicinity of the radio set while the transmitter is on, Do
NOT smoke or light open fires within 25 feet of the gasoline containers of the engine

generator.

RF BURNS

Do not stand on the roof of the shelter or in the path of radiation from the radio set

while the transmitter is on. Turnoffthe power amplifier before climbing to shelter roof,                    ‘

      Tube-types OA2WA and OB2 are used in this equipment and contain radioactive ma-
terial (para 4). These tubes are potentially hazardous when broken; see qualified medical
personnel and the Safety Director if you are exposed to or cut by broken tubes. Use ex-
treme care inreplacing these tubes and followsafe procedures in their handling, storage,
and disposal (para 87).

      Never place radioactive tubes in your pocket.
     Use extreme care not to break radioactive tubes while handling them.
      Never remove radioactive tubes from cartons until ready to use them,

                              Section Il. DESCRIPTION AND DATA

3. Purpose and Use                                tween the radio terminal set operator and two
                                                  remote sites, and the transmission and recep-
Radio Terminal Set AN/TRC-80B (fig. 1) is         tion of four two-wire/four-wire multiplexed
a transportable radio communication facility      telephone circuits. The AN/TRC-80B provides
capable of transmitting and receiving radio       reliable communication up to 160 kilometers
signals in the 4.4-gigahertz (GHz) to 5.0-GHz     (km) (100 statute miles). The AN/TRC-80B
spectrum. Full duplex transmission and recep-     contains an air-inflatable parabolic antenna and
tion of four voice channels and one order wire    an engine generator for primary power. The
channel are provided. The order wire channel      complete radio set is transportable by either
contains one voice frequency circuit and one      air or ground transport facilities. The AN/
radio teletypewriter circuit. The AN/TRC-80B      TRC-80B is designed for use with the Pershing
contains facilities for wire communications be-   Weapons System.

a. Control Panel.                                                  Function

                Control or indicator

FILAMENT VOLTAGE meter ------ Measures klystron filament voltage.

BEAM CURRENT meter ----------- Measures klystron beam current.

BEAM VOLTAGE meter ----------- Measures klystron beam voltage.

POWER OUT meter -------------- Measures direct and reflected power from output transmission line simul-

                                      taneously. Voltage standing wave ratio of output Sater is also indicated      .

                                      on POWER OUT meter.

POWER IN meter ---------------- Measures either reflected or incident input signal power to klystron.

FILAMENT ADJUST MIN-MAX con- | Adjusts klystron filament voltage.

  trol.                               Indicates application of power to control circuits and to klystron filament
FILAMENT indicator -------------

                                      circuit.

FILAMENT ON-OFF switch ------- Controls application of power to blower, control circuits, and klystron

                                      filament circuit.

BEAM ON pushbutton switch ------- Controls application of beam voltage to klystron tube.

BEAM OFF pushbutton switch ----- Removes beam voltage from klystron tube.

TUNE-OPERATE switch ---------- When at TUNE, disables audio alarm during tuning procedures.

REFLECTED-INCIDENT switch---- |Selects either reflected or incident input signal power to klystron for moni-

                                      toring.

ALARM indicator ---------------- When lighted, indicates low-incident power to (less than 800 watts), or high-

                                      reflected power from (more than 80 watts), output transmission line.

Buzzer indicator ----------------- When buzzing, indicates low-incident power (less than 800 watts), or high-

                                      reflected power from (more than 80 watts), output transmission line.

                                      Buzzer is disabled when TUNE-OPERATE switch is at TUNE.

BEAM indicator ------------------ Indicates application of beam voltage to klystron tube.

TIME DELAY indicator ---------- Indicates that 3-minute time delay relay contacts have closed and beam

                                      voltage is available.

DRAWER indicator --------------- When lighted, indicates that three pa drawers are closed and locked.

AIR indicator -------------------- When lighted, indicates sufficient cooling air.
